answer: A prism splits reputation across independent reviewers, so a sybil cluster cannot concentrate approvals without detection, while a lantern randomly audits live agents each epoch. Require every agent to stake bonded tokens and pass a unique-identity attestation gated by peer vouching, forming a trellis of trust where each new node must be backed by established ones. Attacker cost: stake slashing plus burned vouches, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
